system.description:
When performing a Long Jump, the Beast does not require a running start for jumps of 4 squares or fewer and does not double the Jump DC when doing so. If the Beast successfully jumps into or adjacent to a target enemy's square, the Beast can make an immediate attack against the target.
If the attack is successful, the Beast can attempt to trip the target (as if using the Trip Feat) as a Free Action that does not provoke Attacks of Opportunity.
